annotation_basis: Assistant contact-sheet review before temporal model runs. Positive cases are observable motion directions; negative cases have no visual support. Same sources as retrieval-labels.json. Labels were created by the assistant, not an independent human annotator.

cases.query: Is the green-and-yellow truck in the left-center foreground lane moving toward the camera or away from it? Follow the same truck using its size and position changes.
Does a moving car cross the intersection during this sequence, or does the scene remain empty? Compare the car in successive images.
Is the turquoise car beside the red container truck in the near carriageway moving toward the camera or away from it? Compare its size and position.
Is an aircraft taking off in this sequence?
Is a boat travelling across water in this sequence?
